text.en: Cognition is the company behind Devin, an autonomous software engineer used by businesses around the world, from big banks to tech-native startups. As Cognition’s engineering teams write more code, reviewing that work has become a challenge. Cognition sees GPT‑6 Astra’s ability to test its work and show the results as a way to make code review more efficient.

As Cognition’s engineering teams write more code, reviewing that work has become a challenge. Cognition sees GPT‑6 Astra’s ability to test its work and show the results as a way to make code review more efficient.

text.en: Cognition is applying GPT‑6 Astra across its product lineup. “We’ve been using it to make improvements across our product, including the core cloud agent that is Devin, but also our CLI and desktop products,” says Yan.
text.th: Cognition is applying GPT‑6 Astra across its product lineup. “We’ve been using it to make improvements across our product, including the core cloud agent that is Devin, but also our CLI and desktop products,” says Yan.

text.en: In one example, Devin uses Astra to test Otter Run, an iPhone game, and returns a recording of the game running in a simulator, alongside a report identifying checks that passed and areas left untested.
text.th: In one example, Devin uses Astra to test Otter Run, an iPhone game, and returns a recording of the game running in a simulator, alongside a report identifying checks that passed and areas left untested.

text.en: The recording shows the application’s behavior, while the report documents the scope of the testing. Engineers can use those outputs to inspect how the software works and understand what still needs attention.

text.en: Astra is also helping Cognition get back to customers “much quicker,” says Yan. When a customer sends a screenshot of a bug, the team can pass it to Devin using Astra, which fixes the issue and returns a screenshot showing the result.

text.en: Cognition sees stronger testing with GPT‑6 Astra as a path toward a more efficient review process. Having Devin test its work and provide evidence of the results could help engineers evaluate changes with less manual examination of the code.
